[Verse 2]
{chords: Verse 1}
en: Christ, by highest Heaven adored
zh: 基督本为永生王
py: jī dū běn wéi yǒng shēng wáng
en: Christ, the everlasting Lord
zh: 天使敬拜齐颂扬
py: tiān shǐ jìng bài qí sòng yáng
en: Late in time behold him come
zh: 竟然虚己由天降
py: jìng rán xū jǐ yóu tiān jiàng
en: Offspring of the virgin’s womb
zh: 生于童女成人状
py: shēng yú tóng nǚ chéng rén zhuàng
en: Veiled in flesh, the Godhead see
zh: 至高上主成肉体
py: zhì gāo shàng zhǔ chéng ròu tǐ
en: Hail, th' incarnate Deity
zh: 住在人间恩无比
py: zhù zài rén jiān ēn wú bǐ
en: Pleased, as man, with men to dwell
zh: 愿与世人同甘苦
py: yuàn yǔ shì rén tóng gān kǔ
en: Jesus, our Emmanuel
zh: 乃我主以马内利
py: nǎi wǒ zhǔ yǐ mǎ nèi lì
en: Hark! the herald angels sing
zh: 听啊天使高声唱
py: tīng a tiān shǐ gāo shēng chàng
en: Glory to the new-born King!
zh: 荣耀归于新生王
py: róng yào guī yú xīn shēng wáng

[Verse 3]
{chords: Verse 1}
en: Hail! the Heaven-born Prince of Peace
zh: 美哉耶稣和平王
py: měi zāi yē sū hé píng wáng
en: Hail! the Son of Righteousness!
zh: 美哉耶稣为世光
py: měi zāi yē sū wéi shì guāng
en: Light and life to all He brings
zh: 普遍照临万方人
py: pǔ biàn zhào lín wàn fāng rén
en: Risen with healing in His wings
zh: 赐以永生引归真
py: cì yǐ yǒng shēng yǐn guī zhēn
en: Mild He lays His glory by
zh: 谦卑放下天荣尊
py: qiān bēi fàng xià tiān róng zūn
en: Born that man no more may die
zh: 降生救人免沉沦
py: jiàng shēng jiù rén miǎn chén lún
en: Born to raise the sons of earth
zh: 降生罪人能更新
py: jiàng shēng zuì rén néng gēng xīn
en: Born to give them second birth
zh: 降生罪人与主亲
py: jiàng shēng zuì rén yǔ zhǔ qīn
en: Hark! the herald angels sing
zh: 听啊天使高声唱
py: tīng a tiān shǐ gāo shēng chàng
en: Glory to the new-born King!
zh: 荣耀归于新生王
py: róng yào guī yú xīn shēng wáng
